runner.command_hint:
📖 Available commands:
/start — start and choose a project
/list — list available projects
/switch <name> — switch to a project
/new [name] — create a new project
/status — current project and session
/config KEY=VALUE ... — change a live setting; with no args — show the editable ones
/clear — first automatically call /clearattach (clean attachments), then send to Claude (reset context)
/clearattach — delete downloaded attachments of the current project ({where})
/attachsize — show the number and size of downloaded attachments
/kill — kill hung Claude sessions started by the bot
{sandbox_cmd} <command/text> — work in the sandbox in any chat (SANDBOX_ROOT)
/help — this help
